content: Ka mu Jew numu-kooba katudu Herod mee naneadu ka Te Pabe'e Jesus besa tumatugu-kwitu pudu nakase oosoo mu pumme tummatzidu meeoo netamma.
“How haa'a soo John numu baa-wi matzakadu pumme te batsasesapa tuusootabuese, unu poohadooapu? Esoo Jesus John haa'a?”
Ka o'nosoo soo Herod tu pabe'e nodukwa nodukwadoose, soo mogo'ne Herodias mee naneadu.
O'no soo John yise ka Herod ooosapa mee netammano'o, “Gi toge u manakwe. Gi ka Herodias nabaa'yookupana,” mee.
Oosoo yise ka John unnena gi petzabena oo soobatsapana gi oo manakwe ka mu numu-ma suina. Mu numu ka John Te Naa yadooawabe oedyukute.
Ka Herod nawuena sooma'yuna tabeno'o soo Herodias padu mu numu ewana-kobena'yoona oo nugakute. Soo Herod yise tubetse besa soonamme.
Soo Herod yise ka pumme nugakudu meeoo oo netamma, “Tooe hemmadooe u soogwina nu u geakwu.”
Soo tsuadumu yise ka tu pea tubengase soo pea yise meeoo, “Ka John koota tsekea'ase, yise ka oo wo hanese, yise tseda-wi oo wuna,”
Soo Herod yise oo nesootu'adya'e ka John tu batsa tuungukwuna, pana ewa'yoo numu yise oo naka ka Herod unnena.
Soo Herod yise mu tukwutumadu ka John koota tseka'a tuungu.
Umu ka oo wo tseka'ase oo wo tseda-wi oo wunase, yise ka Herodias padu yongagea'a. Soo tsuadumu yise ka Herodias gea.
Mu John pupua'amu ka oo nakase yise mease oo tugudooase ka Te Pabe'e tuukwe'e.

Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus yise ka John nabatsana nakase Te Pabe'e ka tu nakatzimodu-no ka sake-wi kuase ka banunadu ninapatoo natzemangeka numu-wanatoo. Pana ewa'yoo numu ka mu meana nakase ka banunadu-kumi sogo mease oo takwi petuga.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka sake-wi'yoona ka baa-kumabatoo ewow mu numu-baa petuga, oosoo oe'yoona tsebooeke. O'no yise soo Te Pabe'e tutuha mu soobedyana mu tuoegoedu mabesakute.
Ka tu yongokese, numme oo nakatzimodu oo-baa petuse meeoo oo netamma, “U sakwa mu ta'ya ka kwaya'yoona mu kemmase. Umu sakwa puusoo tu tukakwuna hownnekoo mayu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus mee ne netamma, “Gi umu numu tayapana, mu sakwa muusoo yaanoko mu maka.”
Numme ka Te Pabe'e meeoo netamma, “Manegeoo numme tutukutsekoo patzebonomadu tukaba-ga'yoo. Yise waahoo numme too pakwe-ga'yoo.”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo ne netamma, “Yaa nu-matoo oo hanehooke.”

O'no yise soo Te Pabe'e mu numu ka pooena mu ne'aata'akuse ka manegeoo tutukutsekoo patzebonomadu tukaba, noko waahoo pakwe hemehoose toogoopatu poonnese nanesootuhi. O'no yise ka tukaba noko pakwe tzabokase umu pumme nakatzimodu mu ewow numu maka tuungu.

Mu numu yise no'yoona togekoo tukase wutzu'me. Ka tu naduka makwuse numme ka mu tugupenina ka tukaba noko pakwe matsobase oosoo tukapu nagupenina sumu-mano'yoona waha-ma tsebooekudu (12) kawona-wi umu kaanokuhoo.
Mu numu tubetse ewa'yoo namaka (5000 nanana).
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka numme pumme nakatzimodu suu'mu ka sake-wi taya. Umu ka banunadu ninapatoo natzemangekakwu. O'no yise soo Te Pabe'e ka mu ewow numu tuwazoo mu nobe-kwitoosoo ta'ya.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka giba-matoo mease nanesootuha'e, ka tu yongokese oosoo puu suu'mu o.
Ka sake mooasoo banamookwi manikease, unu hukwabetu soo paa unu bayutsungakooha.
Awamooasoo gisoo tu tabuagena soo Te Pabe'e ka sake-witoo meahoo baa-koobakwi kemmaka'e.
Numme tunakatzimodu sake-wi meana ka Te Pabe'e numme-tamme kemmaka'e oo poonne oo-ma unu sui. “Uda! Tsoapa tamme-tamme,” mee numme unnemo'o.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee sookweta unne, “Gi suipana. Nu yow kemma.”
Soo Peter yise mee oo netamma, “U ka togesapa Ne Pabe'ena ka paa-koobakwi namatoo e bikwu. O'no yise nu u oedyukukwu.”
“Yaatoo kemmow,” meeoo soo Te Pabe'e oo netamma. Soo Peter yise ka sake-wi'yoona wuese ka Te Pabe'e-tamme ka baa-koobakwi meahoo.
Ka hukwapa-ma suise too'e padadya'e. Pabatse wa'agenumme, “E Pabe'e e magwetzoi.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka paa-wikoo yabesoo oo tzatseboogese oo magwetzoihoo yise meeoo oo netamma, “Mow u ka gi e soo'oedyukuna. U sakwa yaa manakwana gi waha-tamme tusooyugwepana.”
Ka sake-wisoo mu kuase, soo hukwapa wuyooihoo.
Mu naana ka sake-wi manepunnedu ka Te Pabe'e-matoo nanesootuhikooha, “U tookwa togesapa Te Naa Besaa Tooa.” mee yise oo netamma.
Umu yise ka mangekase ka Gennesaret mee naneadu-kwi petuga.
Mu nanana yise onoko ka Te Pabe'e poonnese oo sopedakwadoona oetu mana tooe nanatuukwe. Mu numu yise mu tu'oegoedu mu nuummadu oo-baa tsato petugonno.
Mu tuoegoedu ka oo-baa petugadyina ka pukwi oo namasooana sukwe tzamayina, besa maniyakwe.
